proof:
:= by
  have h_main : properUnitaryDivisors p = {1} := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro d
    simp only [properUnitaryDivisors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · -- Prove the forward direction: if d is in properUnitaryDivisors p, then d = 1
      intro h
      have h₁ : 1 ≤ d := by linarith
      have h₂ : d < p := by linarith
      have h₃ : d ∣ p := by tauto
      have h₄ : Nat.Coprime d (p / d) := by tauto
      have h₅ : d = 1 := by
        have h₅₁ : d ∣ p := h₃
        have h₅₂ : d ≤ p := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.Prime.pos hp) h₅₁
        have h₅₃ : d < p := h₂
        have h₅₄ : d = 1 := by
          by_contra h₅₄
          have h₅₅ : d ≠ 1 := h₅₄
          have h₅₆ : d > 1 := by
            by_contra h₅₆
            have h₅₇ : d ≤ 1 := by linarith
            have h₅₈ : d = 1 := by
              omega
            contradiction
          have h₅₉ : d ∣ p := h₃
          have h₅₁₀ : d = p := by
            have h₅₁₁ : d ∣ p := h₃
            have h₅₁₂ : d ≤ p := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.Prime.pos hp) h₅₁₁
            have h₅₁₃ : d ≥ 2 := by omega
            have h₅₁₄ : d = p := by
              have h₅₁₅ := Nat.Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd hp d h₅₁₁
              omega
            exact h₅₁₄
          have h₅₁₁ : d < p := h₂
          omega
        exact h₅₄
      simp_all
    · -- Prove the reverse direction: if d = 1, then d is in properUnitaryDivisors p
      intro h
      have h₁ : d = 1 := by simp_all
      rw [h₁]
      have h₂ : 1 < p := Nat.Prime.one_lt hp
      have h₃ : 1 ∣ p := by
        exact Nat.one_dvd p
      have h₄ : Nat.Coprime 1 (p / 1) := by
        simp [Nat.coprime_one_left]
      have h₅ : 1 < p := Nat.Prime.one_lt hp
      constructor
      · -- Prove 1 ∈ Finset.Ico 1 p
        constructor <;> omega
      · -- Prove 1 ∣ p ∧ Nat.Coprime 1 (p / 1)
        constructor <;> simp_all [Nat.coprime_one_left]
        <;> omega
  
  have h_sum : ∑ i ∈ properUnitaryDivisors p, i = 1 := by
    rw [h_main]
    simp [Finset.sum_singleton]
    <;>
    aesop
  
  have h_false : ¬ IsUnitaryPerfect p := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : ∑ i ∈ properUnitaryDivisors p, i = p := h.1
    have h₂ : 0 < p := h.2
    rw [h_sum] at h₁
    have h₃ : p = 1 := by linarith
    have h₄ : p.Prime := hp
    have h₅ : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le h₄
    linarith
  
  exact h_false
